name: Gradient-Based Mesh Optimization via Spherical Harmonics
definition: A gradient-based mesh optimization pipeline that adjusts high-frequency surface details by backpropagating image-space gradients into spherical harmonic coefficients.
summary: Gradient-Based Mesh Optimization via Spherical Harmonics optimizes high-frequency surface details by backpropagating image-space gradients into spherical harmonic coefficients, tilting normals to refine geometry without altering coarse topology.
